lockedCase.speaker: Greg Koukl
lockedCase.sourceExcerpt: >> Well, the nature of freedom in my understanding, my view, is that it can initiate things, okay? You don't have to have in a certain sense deterministic element in your in your soul that forces you to act a certain way. Why did Adam and Eve even this case act the way she did? Because she was capable of initiating a free action. And this free action in terms of rebellion, okay?

targetPacket.sourceExcerpt: humans have a sinful nature and act upon sin, then why did Eve act upon the sin before the fall had happened? Eve must have had a proclivity to sin in order to in order to betray God in the first place. And so, I don't think it suffices to say that the explanation for why we have human beings with a proclivity to sin like Adolf Hitler is because of the fall if the fall is a result of a proclivity to sin from Eve.
targetPacket.claim: If the fall explains humanity's proclivity to sin, Eve's sin before the fall creates a regress because it already presupposes that proclivity.

indispensableComponents.text: The fall is offered as the explanation for humanity's sinful nature and proclivity to sin.
Eve acted on a proclivity to sin before the fall occurred.
The fall therefore cannot explain the very proclivity that produced it.
